weather_refresh_interval_minutes.description: How often the background weather refresh runs, in minutes. WorkManager enforces a 15-minute minimum.

radar_frame_interval_ms.description: Delay between radar animation frames, in milliseconds. Higher is slower. Values outside 100–5000 fall back to 850 in-app.

radar_enabled.description: Hide the radar card if RainViewer or OpenStreetMap tiles become unavailable

walk_card_enabled.description: Show the "time to walk the dog" card on the current-weather screen

open_meteo_enabled.description: Use Open-Meteo for forecasts of cities with coordinates; off falls back to OpenWeatherMap

daily_weather_notifications_enabled.description: Post the daily 9 / 13 / 19 weather-summary notifications. Other notification types will have their own switches.

foreground_refresh_min_minutes.description: Skip the silent refresh when the app returns to the foreground if this city was fetched within this many minutes. 0 always refreshes. Pull-to-refresh is never throttled.

walk_hot_pavement_c.description: Pavement temperature, in °C, at or above which the walk rating is Paws hot and that hour is not walkable. Valid 40–70; anything else uses 52.

walk_max_rain_chance.description: An hour is walkable only when its rain chance, in percent, is below this. Valid 0–100; anything else uses 30.

walk_comfort_min_c.description: Coldest air temperature, in °C, at which an hour counts as comfortable for a walk. Valid -20–20; anything else uses 3. Must be below walk_comfort_max_c, or both use their defaults.

walk_comfort_max_c.description: Warmest air temperature, in °C, at which an hour counts as comfortable for a walk. Valid 15–40; anything else uses 27. Must be above walk_comfort_min_c, or both use their defaults.

walk_hours_start.description: First local hour (0–23, inclusive) a walk may be suggested; 7 = 7 AM. Valid 0–23; anything else uses 7. Must be before walk_hours_end, or both use their defaults.

walk_hours_end.description: Last local hour (0–23, inclusive) a walk may be suggested; 20 = 8 PM. Valid 0–23; anything else uses 20. Must be after walk_hours_start, or both use their defaults.

pet_hot_threshold_c.description: Air temperature, in °C, at or above which the pets look hot and the walk rating is Paws hot. Valid 20–45; anything else uses 30. Must be above pet_cold_threshold_c, or both use their defaults.

pet_cold_threshold_c.description: Air temperature, in °C, at or below which the pets look cold and the walk rating is Too cold. Valid -20–10; anything else uses 0. Must be below pet_hot_threshold_c, or both use their defaults.

analytics_enabled.description: Kill switch: false stops all usage-analytics events and turns Firebase Analytics collection off on every install, on top of the user's own Share usage statistics setting.
